intent: Make the user-approved 30-second Mbappe film with expressive recognizable faces and simplified bodies.
method: Verify FIFA match report; reuse existing endpoint controls, rendering and sound functions; author new art and timeline.
result: New brief and native Blender scene builder written; initial sampled render running.
decision: User explicitly requested the film and new recognizable player treatment; C is not a fixed style.

intent: Make emotional acting and player identity clear while preserving connected motion.
method: Inspect 25 native sample frames and full-size facial/volley views; adjust close-ups, brows, mouths, new shoulder anchors, kit silhouettes, shootout scores and final stadium dimming.
result: Revised native scene with eight distinct player assets and 384 valid limb drivers. Original score and 51 sound cues generated.
decision: Proceed to saved-project checks and full render; resemblance and creative acceptance remain for the user.

intent: Validate the saved film before full rendering.
method: Reopen the native project, evaluate six boot-ball contacts, nine score states, all 720 frames of actor visibility and limb drivers; pack the original soundtrack.
result: All checks passed; source character file remains unchanged and the 30-second soundtrack is embedded.

intent: Keep Thuram clear of the volley trajectory.
method: Move the passer out of shot following the return pass, rebuild native frames, inspect strike and save, rerun all saved-project checks.
result: The passing player clears the goal view. Six geometric contacts, score progression and 720-frame visibility checks pass again; final full render restarted from the corrected project.

intent: Render the corrected full film at delivery resolution.
method: Native Blender render, streamed frame by frame into H.264.
result: 720 frames rendered at 1080×1920 and 24 fps. Finishing and export checks started.

intent: Deliver the requested 30-second film with new player faces, simplified bodies and no narration.
method: Mux original normalized soundtrack; verify complete decoding, resolution, rate, frame count and loudness; inspect 25 exported stills and 24 motion samples; check last frame is black.
result: Final 30.00-second video ready: 1080×1920, 24 fps, 720 frames; stereo48k, -16.09 LUFS, -1.77 dBTP. Editable project includes sound. Final motion and sampled frame review complete.
decision: Complete and ready for user viewing. Perceived likeness and creative acceptance remain with the user. No publication or audience test performed.

intent: Create an attention-grabbing thumbnail that matches the actual animation.
method: Built-in image generation using two film stills for player identity; landscape design followed by a vertical companion; visually inspect both and check files.
result: Two finished PNG layouts with the exact headline 3 GOALS. STILL LOST. Correct character continuity, dark blue/gold contrast, prominent face and trophy.
decision: Ready for user selection/upload. No publishing or click-through measurement performed.
